## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New editor extension, toolbar action, custom field option, or server route
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix in editor, serialization (HTML/JSON/Markdown), RTL, or Strapi Media Library modal
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior changes
- [ ] `docs`: README or inline JSDoc updates
- [ ] `test`: Vitest unit/component test coverage
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`: Build, dependencies, or CI pipeline

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Works in both Strapi **Light** and **Dark** themes and supports **RTL/LTR** text directions
- [ ] HTML/Markdown output is sanitized and safe against XSS
